purpose: Convert recurring Qwen/Gemma IC-support failures into deterministic engineering invariants.

rules.name: numeric_mask_consistency
rules.invariant: declared numeric masks must equal the OR of their declared symbolic bits

rules.name: bit_mask_predicate_semantics
rules.invariant: masked bit predicates must compare against zero or the mask value unless explicitly normalized to Boolean; Execution IR v0 removes raw literal comparisons and permits only symbolic set/clear predicates

rules.name: retry_requires_terminal_observation
rules.invariant: retry and ensure-state paths must end in an observed and verified terminal state

rules.name: timeout_enters_uncertain_state
rules.invariant: an unresolved hardware timeout must transition the controller model to an uncertain state

rules.name: uncertain_state_forbids_normal_cleanup
rules.invariant: normal register cleanup must not assume controller accessibility after an unresolved busy timeout

rules.name: destructive_transition_no_fallthrough
rules.invariant: destructive operations require an authorization barrier and destructive reset workflows must stop after reset/re-identification

rules.name: option_security_representation_separation
rules.invariant: logical byte, complement byte, encoded storage representation, and programming transaction representation must be distinct and arithmetically consistent

rules.name: memory_geometry_consistency
rules.invariant: flash size, page size, page count, erase granularity, and address range must be mutually consistent

rules.name: target_address_bounds
rules.invariant: program/erase accesses must declare exact target-geometry or option-profile bounds and alignment; runtime concrete-address enforcement remains a backend responsibility

rules.name: policy_semantic_isolation
rules.invariant: one policy field must not control semantically unrelated behavior; a separate execution-policy contract is still required

rules.name: suboperation_error_propagation
rules.invariant: failed or uncertain sub-operations must propagate failure and block dependent actions

rules.name: operation_mode_lifecycle
rules.invariant: operation-control modes must have explicit entry, terminal observation, and safe normal-path exit semantics

rules.name: status_flag_lifecycle
rules.invariant: stale status and W1C flags must be explicitly cleared before an operation and must not be mistaken for current-operation status

rules.name: self_check_requires_evidence
rules.invariant: a model self-check may report PASS only when the reviewed mechanism exists and coverage evidence is present; otherwise use NOT_APPLICABLE or FAIL
